method:
Weight lab: backtest the current research-score weights against competing weightings, and
re-grade the prospective screens with overlap-aware statistics.

part_a_main_model.underpowered_note: fewer than 20 out-of-sample periods: fitted rows are illustrative, no ranking between configs is statistically supported

full_window.window: all periods (fixed configs are not fitted; *_wf rows are OOS-only)

oos_window.window: periods 7+ (all configs scored on identical periods)

part_a_all_names.universe: all scored names per config (samples differ between configs)

full_window.window: all periods (fixed configs are not fitted; *_wf rows are OOS-only)

oos_window.window: periods 24+ (all configs scored on identical periods)

swing.caveat: stores hold only each screen's published top rows (range-restricted sample); ~4.7 independent windows; descriptive only

earnings_timeliness.caveat: stores hold only each screen's published top rows (range-restricted sample); ~2.2 independent windows; descriptive only

momentum.caveat: stores hold only each screen's published top rows (range-restricted sample); ~2.2 independent windows; descriptive only

disclosures: Part A leg scores are pre-modifier. Fundamental legs resolve for only a minority of names per period (the pre-2026-08-24 enrichment cap), so fundamentals blends are graded on a selected subset; market_behavior covers the whole universe.
growth and news_sentiment legs have no historical data in the panel and are excluded; current weights are renormalized over the live legs.
No production weight is changed by this report. Per docs/VALIDATION-METHODOLOGY.md a change needs out-of-sample IC improvement after deflation for the trials run here.
